title: MUSIC.md frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a MUSIC.md agent-readable music context file. Spec: specs/music-md/SPEC.md (v0.1). Everything beyond music_spec/scope/title is optional — omit over invent: an absent key means 'not stated', never a default.

music_spec.description: Spec version this file targets, e.g. "0.1".

profile_pack.description: Path/URL to a profile-pack.json (schemas/profile-pack.schema.json). May reference a private location without inlining content (SPEC §5.5).

profile.description: Track scope: bound profile id. Omit if unbound — never guess.

album_manifest.description: Album scope: path to the album.json this file annotates.

functional_intent.description: Vibe-state ids or free-text functional targets the music serves.

generation.description: Mandatory when any AI contributed audio, lyrics, or arrangement (SPEC §5.3). Absence asserts human-made.

provider.description: e.g. suno | udio | elevenlabs | lyria | stable-audio | ace-step | heartmula | live | daw | hybrid | human | other

prompt_provenance.description: Where prompts/takes are logged (e.g. a take-log path).

license_state.description: The claimed license basis, e.g. suno-paid-commercial (a license, not ownership). Unknown/absent = not cleared (SPEC §5.4).

ai_disclosure.description: Plain-language disclosure; mapped to DDEX-style fields at export.

measurements.description: Measured values override declared ones for scoring/gating (SPEC §5.2).
